turns.userMessage:
Build a square watchtower: footprint about 6x6 studs, at least 10 bricks tall, with a wider battlement platform on top (about 8x8 studs, with a parapet ring around its edge). Two colors maximum, sensible courses with overlapped seams (running bond), no floating parts. 60-120 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 12x12 studs; height at least 240 LDU (10 bricks); use at least 40 parts.
